body_markdown:
[All updates](https://frigade.com/updates)


You can now add both an image and a video to the same step in the Flow editor. This was previously supported only via the advanced YAML editor and adding an image to a step disabled the video field and the other way round. Now we support both! Video uploads accept MP4 files.
